visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 1/12: Three dimensions of justice
visual_blocks.preview: DISTRIBUTIVE -> who receives what: transfers, reservation, services, social security

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 2/12: Equality ladder
visual_blocks.preview: FORMAL EQUALITY -> same rule for all; structural disadvantage survives the rule

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 3/12: Constitutional anchor
visual_blocks.preview: PREAMBLE -> socialist republic; justice social, economic and political

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 4/12: Capability standard
visual_blocks.preview: FUNCTIONINGS -> achieved states: being nourished, being healthy, being literate

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 5/12: Authorities bank
visual_blocks.preview: RAWLS -> difference principle: inequality just only if it benefits the least advantaged

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 6/12: Social protection floor card
visual_blocks.preview: INSTRUMENT -> Social Protection Floors Recommendation, 2012, No. 202

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 7/12: Universalism against targeting
visual_blocks.preview: UNIVERSALISM -> lower stigma, lower exclusion error, higher cost, higher inclusion error

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 8/12: Equity types
visual_blocks.preview: HORIZONTAL EQUITY -> equals treated equally

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 9/12: Welfare-state models
visual_blocks.preview: RESIDUAL -> state acts after family and market fail; means-tested and stigmatised

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 10/12: Five-stage welfare mechanism
visual_blocks.preview: CONSTITUTIONAL FOUNDATION -> Preamble and Directive Principles set the direction

visual_blocks.heading: ASCII MASTER FLOW - PANEL 11/12: Five recurring welfare gaps
visual_blocks.preview: IDENTIFICATION -> the eligible person is not correctly listed; fix the roll, not the slogan
